verdict.rationale: Superpowers is operated via natural-language triggers (skills auto-invoke) and slash commands like /brainstorm, /write-plan, /execute-plan across multiple harnesses (Claude Code, Devin, Hermes, Codex), with docs and community confirming this is the primary interaction mode. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that slash-command/NL invocation works flawlessly across all supported harnesses, and no evidence of a full non-command conversational mode outside skill triggers.
